contract_name: SSG shared public page SEO projection
status: Proposed coordinated extension. Existing fields are documentary evidence, not a claim of live support.
transport_decision: Add page_seo to existing page-level public GET responses; no mandatory separate /api/seo/page endpoint. Page content and page_seo are serialized from the same committed public projection.
naming: snake_case REST; explicit mapping to existing camelCase persistence

HistoricalDate.type: RFC3339 datetime string with explicit timezone | YYYY-MM-DD date-only | null
rules: Preserve verified historical precision.
Never invent midnight for date-only history.
New publication events use UTC instants.
Unknown remains null.
No future publication/modification for an already public page.

required_fields.route_id: string: stable route identity, not user-controlled path
required_fields.template: string: approved template identifier from PAGE-TEMPLATE-MATRIX.json
required_fields.url: absolute URL: current canonical route under trusted configured origin
required_fields.alternate_urls: { bg: absolute URL|null, en: absolute URL|null }: only real published equivalents, including current locale
required_fields.seo_title: string|null: resolved approved localized title; production publication readiness rejects missing required title
required_fields.seo_description: string|null: approved localized summary; never fabricated from unrelated/private text
required_fields.og_image: PublicMedia|null: existing allowlisted approved media DTO; explicit approved override or documented template fallback
required_fields.published_at: HistoricalDate: original first publication of this localized page/article when known
required_fields.public_modified_at: HistoricalDate: last significant published change of this localized URL projection
required_fields.article_modified_at: HistoricalDate: substantive editorial change to the Article entity; null when unknown or not applicable
required_fields.public_revision_key: opaque non-secret string: committed public projection generation shared with body; not a timestamp substitute

required_fields.intended_index: boolean: production policy for the current published URL before environment protection
required_fields.sitemap_eligible: boolean: true only for approved current canonical published indexable 200 URL included by sitemap policy
required_fields.environment_override: boolean: true when DEV/staging/prelaunch controls override intended policy

invariants: sitemap_eligible implies intended_index; public sitemap still disabled by protected environment policy.
Private routes never enter the public metadata/feed projection.
Robots directives do not replace authentication.

SeoUrlExisting.compatibility_change: lastmod definition widens prior ISODateTime|null to HistoricalDate; coordinate date-only parser support

rules: snapshot_id is a proposed additive field, not established deployed API.
Each continuation uses the same snapshot_id.
No mixing route pages from different export snapshots.
Null lastmod means XML element omitted.

query.snapshot_id: UUID optional on first request, required with after_id

rules: Protected staff authorization; private,no-store,noindex.
Same selector/serializer as production feed.
Never dump private records, tokens, unpublished body or internal customer data.
initialize_import only declared migrated locale before first publication here
correct_verified_history requires staff permission, reason, current concurrency token and audit
no arbitrary public_modified_at clock input on ordinary writes
all three DateEvidence objects explicit
known values require verifiable locale-specific provenance
private source_ref never serialized in public DTO

fields.source_ref: nonblank string <=1000 characters when value known, otherwise null

rules: unknown remains null
capture/import date not proof of publication
reject future or impossible chronology
preserve date-only precision

Alias from same authoritative source as page_seo.published_at; broaden date-only precision deliberately.

page_level_consumers.context: assembled HOME; own root projection, not one arbitrary source section
catalogue/curated category. Resolve metadata by actual page route and query, not first product.
editorial/content list route. Bind metadata to actual list page, not first article.
store index route metadata via same public projection/adapter
contact page; shared contact facts do not independently identify every consumer
current policy route; historical version rules preserved
approved static public routes without business endpoints; same metadata model

in_transaction: Validate expected version, publish eligibility and route uniqueness.
Compare old/new semantic public projections per locale.
Persist approved content/current route/date changes and public_revision_key.
Persist dependency-aware invalidation outbox event with original event time.
after_commit: Retry failed delivery idempotently with original revision/time.
Never advance dates because worker retries or cache regenerates.
publication_events.not_public: Evidence references and private audit provenance are not serialized into public page_seo.

examples.note: Synthetic valid type examples only; not live SSG content or endpoint responses.

article_page_seo.seo_description: Синтетичен пример за формата на данните.

examples.explanation: Example article original date is known only to day; a current related-product card changed the page, not the article body. Article.dateModified must be omitted; WebPage/date and sitemap can reflect the actual page update.

acceptance_invariants: Page content, SEO projection and timestamps share public_revision_key.
Original published_at never becomes import/deploy/DNS time.
Unknown historical dates remain null and output date fields are omitted.
Article.dateModified reads article_modified_at, not generic technical or page date.
Sitemap lastmod reads localized page public_modified_at.
BG-only published content change does not advance unaffected EN.
Shared visible commercial changes refresh actual affected locales and list projections.
Hidden/internal facts and no-op changes do not advance public dates.
Cache invalidation set may be larger than significant-date-change set.
DEV public SEO feed remains gated while protected diagnostics permit acceptance.
Whole-cart EUR2000 limit is not a public-product indexability threshold.

original_publication_mapping.status: Proposed optional field for an own SSG work translated/summarized later
rules: Preserve original work publication separately from actual first publication of the new language version.
Visible label must say original publication; Article.datePublished describes represented current locale work.
Existing migrated same-locale article preserves its own verified original date.
No invented external-source attribution for SSG-owned content.

collection_context.when: Only when existing selector inputs cannot unambiguously resolve the public landing-page route
collection_context.validation: Route ID, locale, template and selector must match; omission uses base-list context
collection_context.compatibility: Validate new query fields before frontend use. Legacy array GET default stays array; include_page_seo=true explicitly returns {items:[legacy records],page_seo} from one committed snapshot. Object GETs add page_seo. Static gaps reuse route-backed content adapter.

sitemap_pagination_policy: Base list URL only in sitemap. Valid unfiltered page 2+ remains indexable/self-canonical/reachable by links but is excluded from sitemap.

observed_live_sample.source: Lead agent read-only Postman visible response
observed_live_sample.scope: One visible sample; not full response schema certification or history verification

format: Descriptive typed contract/reference JSON; not executable JSON Schema or OpenAPI. Implement runtime DTOs and publish actual OpenAPI/Postman schemas.

array_opt_in.consistency: Read and serialize items/page_seo from same committed projection; new frontend opts in.

dev_propagation_acceptance.scope: HTML + metadata + protected sitemap preview after ordinary successful publication
dev_propagation_acceptance.failure: Visible retryable propagation failure; no false complete acknowledgement or timestamp bump on retry

product.effect: Draft only; explicit publish applies reviewed values

policy.constraint: Immutable accepted policy text/version unchanged; route metadata corrections use existing route-backed adapter where needed

compatibility_omission_rule: Older replacement clients omitting newly added SEO/history fields preserve stored values. New records initialize nullable SEO only; readiness applies. Explicit null clears optional SEO override, not historical dates. Date clearing requires correct_verified_history with audit.
historical_saved_response_evidence: evidence/dates-history-excerpt.json: saved own article API published_at 2026-11-13 versus approved original 2022-06-02. Not current live read; requires date-history import/HTML verification.
